messages:
maria (docs): Heads-up: PR #8423 needs to resolve KMS role mapping and cert-bundle instructions for the on‑prem upgrade guide — prepping to merge Wed.

liam (eng): Saw the comments. The role mapping example was using AWS IAM names; need to show a Hashi/HSM pkcs11 example. I'll add a snippet.

sasha (security): Please include exact file perms and a systemd drop-in for the key manager service. Also clarify that PKCS#11 URIs must reference /etc/hsm/keys and never be world-readable.

ron (support): Seeing a few customers hit "invalid cert bundle" during airgap upgrades. Can we add a short troubleshooting section with `openssl` checks and expected fingerprint validation?

deploybot: CI: docs-pr/8423 build passed; linkcheck failed on external HSM vendor doc (403).

maria (docs): Thanks. @liam can you add a small `role-mapping` YAML and an offline bundle mirroring step? Also a short note for support when vendor links 403 (point to archived mirror).

liam (eng): Will do. Proposed snippet:

```
# role-mapping.yaml
kms_roles:
  - name: redwood-admin
    hsm_role_id: 0x01
    capabilities:
      - sign
      - rotate
    can_rotate: true
```

And offline bundle steps:
1) scp bundle.tar.gz to bastion
2) verify `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz` against signed manifest
3) run `./installer --airgap --bundle ./bundle.tar.gz`

sasha (security): Add explicit warning: verify the manifest signature and file perms before install. Example systemd commands to include:
`systemctl restart redwood-keyd`
`journalctl -fu redwood-keyd`
Also recommend `chmod 640 /etc/hsm/keys/*` and `chown root:redwood /etc/hsm/keys`.

ron (support): For the "invalid cert bundle" case add these quick checks:
- `openssl pkcs12 -info -in certs.p12` to inspect the keystore contents
- ensure CRL/OCSP endpoints are not required in airgap (OCSP fail causes validation fail)
- workaround: installer flag `--no-ocsp` for truly offline installs
Include example `openssl` commands in the troubleshooting subsection.

maria (docs): Great. Also need to adjust wording for HSM PIN rotation: customers must pause traffic on serving nodes or do a rolling canary. Add a canary procedure and explicit rollback steps.

liam (eng): Added canary steps to the PR: rotate pin on a single HSM node, monitor key-manager logs and KV-cache warmup, then proceed cluster-wide. Note about KV-cache: expect a short spike in 503s unless warmup is done.

deploybot: CI: docs-pr/8423 linkcheck re-run — external vendor doc still 403; recommendation: point to archived vendor FAQ in infra repo or add vendor excerpt into our docs (small quoted snippet).

maria (docs): I'll swap the link to the archived copy and push the change. Final pre-merge checklist:
- role-mapping YAML plus pkcs11 example
- cert bundle troubleshooting with `openssl` examples
- airgap bundle commands + `sha256` verification
- explicit systemd and file-perm notes
- HSM PIN rotation canary + rollback steps
- replace or mirror broken vendor link

Target merge: 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC — merge once CI is green and @sasha gives final OK.

liam (eng): :thumbsup: will have edits by EOD.

sasha (security): :eyes: I'll do a final pass for perms and least-privilege advice.

ron (support): If helpful I can draft a one-page support playbook snippet to drop into the troubleshooting section.

maria (docs): Thanks all — merging once CI green and @sasha approves.
